Provider series are evaluated separately; unverified cross-provider party identities are not joined.
Parliamentary targets are largest vote shares, not seat or government control.
Candidates and political parties can change. Historical labels identify blocs rather than certified future nominees.
One result yields only a descriptive baseline; sparse and stale data are labelled.
The Türkiye 2028 Erdoğan-win view is an explicit preset scenario, excluded from model validation.
